items.period: Shuowen seal-script style (Han lexicographic tradition; modern digital redraw)
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 忘 in Shuowen seal-script style, showing the received 心-plus-亡 analysis in a later standardized script tradition.
items.alt: Black vector drawing of 忘 in a seal-script style on a white background.
items.selection_reason: Commons description page identifies the depicted graph and seal-script style, links the source image record, and states public-domain terms for the SVG representation. The image helps illustrate the later form tradition; it is not presented as an artifact photograph or earliest form.
items.rights: Public domain according to the exact Commons file description page; modern redraw, with no claim of artifact-photo status.

limitations.text: Direct fetch of the selected SVG failed in the web tool. The Commons page establishes its identity, stated style, source attribution, original file link, and rights; visual inspection remains for the downstream image review.
The source page lists bronze and oracle variants, but individual artifact-linked images were not retrievable in this pass, so no artifact image is proposed.
